The cottages are presented to a high standard throughout which reflects in the high repeat custom. There is also previous planning permission for 2 additional lodges and also a swimming pool. This easily managed complex comes with a comprehensive handover, ensuring a seamless transition, and early viewings are highly recommended. All these places offer shops, cafes, pubs and supermarkets. Only minutes’ drive away are both the A30 and A38 connecting all parts of Cornwall, and the M5 motorway for the rest of the UK. A main line railway station is also only a short drive away, connecting London and beyond.
